parameters.jsCode:
const d     = items[0].json;
const dates = $('Get Req. Dates1').first().json;

const location_id   = 'west-republic';
const location_name = d.account_name || 'West Republic';
const platform      = 'meta';
const { quarter, year, prev_quarter, prev_year } = dates;

const weeklyRows = (d.current_weekly || []).map(w => ({
  location_id,
  location_name,
  platform,
  quarter,
  year,
  week_start:  w.week_start,
  spend:       w.spend,
  impressions: w.impressions,
  clicks:      w.clicks,
  conversions: w.conversions,
  cpl:         w.cpl,
  ctr:         w.ctr
}));

const summaryRow = {
  location_id,
  location_name,
  platform,
  quarter,
  year,
  total_spend:        d.current_totals?.spend        ?? 0,
  total_impressions:  d.current_totals?.impressions  ?? 0,
  total_clicks:       d.current_totals?.clicks       ?? 0,
  total_conversions:  d.current_totals?.conversions  ?? 0,
  cpl:                d.current_totals?.cpl          ?? null,
  ctr:                d.current_totals?.ctr          ?? 0,
  prev_quarter,
  prev_year,
  prev_total_spend:       d.prev_totals?.spend       ?? 0,
  prev_total_conversions: d.prev_totals?.conversions ?? 0,
  prev_cpl:               d.prev_totals?.cpl         ?? null,
  prev_ctr:               d.prev_totals?.ctr         ?? 0
};

const campaignRows = (d.current_top_campaigns || []).map(c => ({
  location_id,
  platform,
  quarter,
  year,
  campaign_id:   c.campaign_id,
  campaign_name: c.campaign_name,
  spend:         c.spend,
  impressions:   c.impressions,
  clicks:        c.clicks,
  conversions:   c.conversions,
  cpl:           c.cpl,
  ctr:           c.ctr
}));

return [{ json: { weekly_metrics: weeklyRows, quarterly_summary: summaryRow, top_campaigns: campaignRows } }];
